title: Canonical etale evaluation biduality transpose
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X$ a scheme, and $Q,M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The canonical evaluation-biduality map $\eta_{Q,M}:M\to R\mathcal Hom_R(R\mathcal Hom_R(M,Q),Q)$ is the transpose, under the derived tensor--Hom adjunction, of $R\mathcal Hom_R(M,Q)\otimes_R^L M\xrightarrow{\sigma}M\otimes_R^L R\mathcal Hom_R(M,Q)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}}Q$, where $\sigma$ is the canonical signed derived tensor symmetry [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] [def-kun-derived-tensor] [lem-kun-tensor-sym].

source.place: Expose XVII, Definition 0.8 and Proposition 7.6.3, p. 311: the canonical evaluation transpose used in the dualizing hypothesis.
